Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Manoj - 33 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Hema - 30 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Anita - 65 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
4. Vinod - 63 years, king, father
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
5. Kavita - 25 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
4. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Manoj stands on the training ground. Hema and Kavita stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's do something fun today."

[Manoj practises sword fighting.]

Manoj: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Manoj draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Manoj (happily): "Kavita, are you okay?"

[Manoj mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Hema: "Kavita, listen!"

[Manoj swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Manoj: "Really?"

[Manoj shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Hema: "Let's see."

[Hema rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Hema: "That's great!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Anita: "So, here we are!"

[Manoj pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Manoj: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Manoj sips red wine.]

Manoj: "That's easy."

[Manoj drinks a beer.]

Manoj (laughing): "Let's see."

[Manoj staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Manoj: "Careful!"

[Manoj and Mother clink their glasses.]

Manoj: "What next?"

Scene 3: The bathroom - Day

[Manoj stands in the bathroom. Anita and Vinod stand near him.]

Manoj: "So, here we are!"

[Manoj shaves in front of the mirror.]

Manoj (surprised): "That's easy."

Scene 4: The royal court - Day

Anita: "What a nice place."

[Manoj sits down on the throne.]

Manoj: "That was such a fun day!"
